serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: OpenLM Platform is a software-as-a-service for engineering and enterprise software license management, hosted by OpenLM on AWS in the United States. It monitors license usage across license servers, workstations, dongles and SaaS platforms, shows who uses which license and when, and helps organizations reclaim unused licenses, control access and plan renewals. It is sold in two plans, Monitoring and Automation, with optional add-on services; all are listed under certified services.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: OpenLM FedRAMP trust center: public service information and, after approval, the certification package documents.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Request access at https://trust.openlm.com/request-access.html. Confirm your email address through the link we send. Addresses ending in .gov or .mil are approved automatically; other addresses are checked by OpenLM within 2 business days.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Monitors all application types (network, named user, standalone): license server monitoring, agent-based usage monitoring and discovery (applications and web URLs), usage, denials and inventory reporting, identification of unused license features, and directory synchronization. Security category: Moderate.

Everything in the Monitoring plan, plus project and group usage, alerts and notifications with ITSM integration, DLL monitoring, compliance and SAM cost management, geo compliance, roles and permissions, and License Access Control. Security category: Moderate.
Add-on to either plan (additional tokens required): idle session monitoring and automatic reclaiming of unused licenses. Security category: Moderate.
Included in the Automation plan; available as an add-on or standalone service: controls who can access which licenses. Security category: Moderate.
Add-on, not included in the plans: advanced license usage analytics and reporting. Security category: Moderate.
Add-on, not included in the plans: license operations for high-performance computing environments. Security category: Moderate.
Add-on, not included in the plans: monitoring of USB license dongles and hardware keys: location, usage and unauthorized devices. Security category: Moderate.
